title: unrecognised model provider
notes: The diagnostic IS printed correctly and located; the defect is that it is then reported a second time as a traceback. `async_generate_text` (pdl_llms.py) raises on the event-loop thread, and `update_end_nanos` calls future.result() from an unguarded concurrent.futures done-callback, so Python prints 'exception calling callback' plus ~20 frames after the real message.
